name: Mechanic
description: Dark, animated mechanic-shop site with bold hero and service blocks

slots.description: Main headline over the workshop hero photo, punchy, no punctuation at end
One-sentence supporting line under the headline
About section heading (an info icon precedes it)
About paragraph — what the shop does and how it treats customers, 2-3 sentences
Heading of the three-card reasons section (a wrench icon precedes it)
Title of reason card 1
Body of reason card 1, one or two sentences
Title of reason card 2
Body of reason card 2, one or two sentences
Title of reason card 3
Body of reason card 3, one or two sentences
Heading of the appointment band (gated by booking_form; a calendar icon precedes it)
One-sentence invitation to book ahead, shown in the appointment band
Closing call-to-action band heading
Short footer tagline about the business
Services page H1 shown on the page hero (a wrench icon precedes it)
Intro paragraph above the service blocks, 1-2 sentences

Grid of service blocks, 3-9 items; each item: `

  • Service name

    Short description.

    • ` (icon class may be bxs-wrench, bxs-car or bxs-battery)
Contact page H1 shown on the page hero (a contact icon precedes it)
Intro paragraph inviting visitors to get in touch, 1-2 sentences
Phone line text in the contact list — real confirmed phone number only, else an invitation to call
Email line text in the contact list — real confirmed email only
Street address line in the contact list — real confirmed address only
Opening-hours table rows; each row: `DayHours`, seven rows Monday-Sunday
Submit button label of the lead form
Newsletter band heading (gated by newsletter_signup; an envelope icon precedes it)
One-sentence reason to subscribe, shown in the newsletter band

imageNotes: header-bg.webp: dark workshop scene used as the hero backdrop on all pages (desktop); header-bg-mobile.webp: smaller crop of the same scene for viewports up to 1024px. Both sit under a primary-colour multiply overlay, so near-monochrome garage/tools photos work best. workshop-oil-check.webp: CC0 photo of a mechanic checking oil in an engine bay (provenance in SOURCE.md), shown as the about-section image on index.html (3:2 crop, stacks above the text on mobile) — swap for the customer's own shop photo via the assets pipeline.
